description: This database lists 1,055 georeferenced dams in the Mekong basin with attributes such as status, dam height, reservoir volume and installed capacity. The dams were compiled from 18 databases (six global, five regional and seven national), checked against satellite imagery in Google Earth and supplemented from reports, papers, news and websites; dam elevation and catchment area were added by GIS analysis. Five CSV files split the dams by decade from the 1980s to the post-2020s, the last including dams under construction and planned dams. It was produced at Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, from a final-year project, and published on DR-NTU (Data) in January 2024 under CC BY 4.0 as 34-variable tables. Caveats: coverage is the Mekong basin only, it is a student compilation whose source quality varies, and planned dams depend on public information. Simulation uses: cascade and transboundary analysis of Mekong reservoirs, hazard exposure and capacity planning of hydropower and water storage. Related record: GeoDAR (data-geodar-georeferenced-global-dams-reservoirs).
